title: uno: Multiplayer UNO Game in R
text: uno package simulates full multiplayer UNO game using realistic rules automatic CPU-driven turns. includes: Shuffling dealing full UNO deck Turn-based logic direction reversal Support action cards (Skip, Reverse, +2, Wild, Wild Draw 4) Automatic winner detection Final scoring summary output Ideal teaching game simulations, functional programming, AI experimentation.

what: Create a Complete UNO Deck — create_uno_deck
title: Create a Complete UNO Deck — create_uno_deck
text: Constructs full UNO card deck consisting 108 cards, following official game rules. includes number cards (0–9), action cards (Skip, Reverse, +2), wild cards (Wild, Wild Draw 4). resulting deck returned tidy tibble sorted color, type, value.

title: Create a Complete UNO Deck — create_uno_deck
code: create_uno_deck()

title: Create a Complete UNO Deck — create_uno_deck
text: tibble exactly 108 rows 3 columns: color – Card color: one "red", "green", "blue", "yellow", "wild" value – Card value: string representing number, action, wild type (e.g., "5", "+2", "wild_draw4") type – Card type: one "number", "action", "wild"

title: Create a Complete UNO Deck — create_uno_deck
text: four colors (red, green, blue, yellow) includes: One 0 card Two number card 1–9 Two action card: "skip", "reverse", "+2" Additionally: Four "wild" cards Four "wild_draw4" cards - function uses expand_grid() uncount() generate replicate UNO cards.  - Number action cards repeated according official UNO rules.  - function returns tibble 108 cards structured use simulations. deck can passed directly downstream functions deal_hands play_game.

title: Create a Complete UNO Deck — create_uno_deck
code: # Generate the UNO deck deck <- create_uno_deck()  # Validate the total card count nrow(deck)  # Should return 108 #> [1] 108  # Check card distribution table(deck$type) #>  #> action number   wild  #>     24     76      8   # Preview color types unique(deck$color) #> [1] "blue"   "green"  "red"    "wild"   "yellow"  # Use the deck to deal to players hands <- deal_hands(deck, n_players = 4) sapply(hands$hands, nrow) #> Player_1 Player_2 Player_3 Player_4  #>        7        7        7        7

what: Deal Cards to UNO Players — deal_hands
title: Deal Cards to UNO Players — deal_hands
text: Randomly shuffles UNO deck distributes 7 cards player. Cards dealt 7 sequential rounds, one card time player, maintaining fairness order. dealing, function also initializes discard pile placing one card remaining deck face-.

title: Deal Cards to UNO Players — deal_hands
code: deal_hands(deck, n_players = 4)

title: Deal Cards to UNO Players — deal_hands
text: deck tibble representing full UNO deck generated create_uno_deck. Must contain 108 UNO cards columns: color, value, type. n_players integer indicating number players game. default 4, reflects standard size quick simulations.  version supports number players (≥2) based deck size. Note: Future versions package aim support larger player counts built-validation dynamic rule adaptation.

title: Deal Cards to UNO Players — deal_hands
text: named list following components: hands – named list tibbles, containing 7 cards dealt player. Names follow format "Player_1", "Player_2", etc. deck – tibble representing remaining draw pile hands discard card removed. discard – one-row tibble containing top card placed discard pile start game.

title: Deal Cards to UNO Players — deal_hands
text: function commonly used first step setting game using setup_game play_game. - cards dealt using nested loop: one card per player per round, repeated 7 times.  - player's hand stored named list (e.g., Player_1, Player_2, etc.).  - One card moved remaining deck serve opening discard card. result can passed directly downstream functions like play_turns_loop simulate gameplay.

title: Deal Cards to UNO Players — deal_hands
code: # Generate a new UNO deck deck <- create_uno_deck()  # Deal cards to 4 players deal <- deal_hands(deck, 4)  # View player 1's hand deal$hands$Player_1 #> # A tibble: 7 × 3 #>   color  value type   #>   <chr>  <chr> <chr>  #> 1 blue   0     number #> 2 blue   8     number #> 3 yellow skip  action #> 4 green  1     number #> 5 red    8     number #> 6 red    8     number #> 7 red    +2    action  # View top of discard pile deal$discard #> # A tibble: 1 × 3 #>   color value type   #>   <chr> <chr> <chr>  #> 1 red   4     number  # Check hand sizes (should all be 7) sapply(deal$hands, nrow) #> Player_1 Player_2 Player_3 Player_4  #>        7        7        7        7   # Examine remaining deck structure str(deal$deck) #> tibble [79 × 3] (S3: tbl_df/tbl/data.frame) #>  $ color: chr [1:79] "blue" "yellow" "green" "red" ... #>  $ value: chr [1:79] "reverse" "9" "9" "7" ... #>  $ type : chr [1:79] "action" "number" "number" "number" ...

text: named list final game results: winner – Character. Name winning player (e.g., "Player_1"). hands – Named list tibbles representing player’s final hand.   winner empty hand. discard – Tibble showing full discard pile used throughout game.

title: Simulate a Complete UNO Game — play_game
text: function user-friendly entry point ideal batch simulations, gameplay testing, educational demos, scoring. function performs two main stages: Game initialization – setup_game shuffles deck, deals hands, sets turn order. title: Simulate UNO Turn-by-Turn Gameplay — play_turns_loop
text: Executes main gameplay loop UNO iterating player turns winner found. Handles playable card logic, card draws, action cards (Skip, Reverse, +2), wild card behavior, including forced draws color changes.

title: Simulate UNO Turn-by-Turn Gameplay — play_turns_loop
code: play_turns_loop(hands, deck, discard, direction, turn)

title: Simulate UNO Turn-by-Turn Gameplay — play_turns_loop
text: hands named list tibbles representing player’s hand. tibble must columns color, value, type. deck tibble representing remaining draw pile. Cards removed players must draw. discard tibble representing discard pile. last row treated top card play. direction integer indicating turn order. 1 clockwise (default), -1 counter-clockwise. turn Integer. current player’s turn index (1-based). updated automatically within loop.

title: Simulate UNO Turn-by-Turn Gameplay — play_turns_loop
text: named list following components: winner – character string. Name winning player (e.g., "Player_3"). hands – named list tibbles showing final hands players.   winner zero cards. discard – tibble representing final discard pile, including last played card.

title: Simulate UNO Turn-by-Turn Gameplay — play_turns_loop
text: function best used internally play_game custom simulations want experiment specific starting states. - Handles action cards: "skip", "reverse", "+2", "wild", "wild_draw4"  - playable card, player draws 1 deck  - Turn logic accounts action card effects (e.g., next player drawing, reversing direction)  - Wilds automatically assign random color

title: Simulate UNO Turn-by-Turn Gameplay — play_turns_loop

title: Compute Final UNO Scores — score_game
text: function designed called output play_game(). returns named integer vector remaining card counts per player, sorted fewest cards . - result highlights winner (score 0), followed players remaining cards.  - function assumes game_state$hands named list tibbles representing   player's hand game loop ended.  - sorted output makes easy visualize rankings detect close finishes competitive analysis simulations. function useful summary statistics, ranking output, leaderboard generation extended gameplay sessions Monte Carlo simulations.
